gbe_todesursachen.name: Sterbefälle nach äußeren Ursachen und ihren Folgen (ab 1998) [Deaths by external causes and their consequences, from 1998], selection ICD-10 X85-Y09 Tätlicher Angriff (assault)
gbe_todesursachen.publisher: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Todesursachenstatistik; served by Gesundheitsberichterstattung des Bundes (GBE-Bund, gbe-bund.de), table no. 630
gbe_todesursachen.licence: Impressum: '© Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), 2026. Vervielfältigung und Verbreitung, auch auszugsweise, mit Quellenangabe gestattet. ... Die Weiterverwendung ist sowohl für nicht gewerbliche als auch gewerbliche Zwecke erlaubt ... Eine Quellenangabe ist jedoch erforderlich ... Änderungen ... sind als solche kenntlich zu machen.'
gbe_todesursachen.notes: Cause-of-death (vital registration) counts of deaths from assault, ICD-10 X85-Y09, not police-recorded offences. Breakdowns each taken one at a time with all other features at their total: sex (Male/Female), 21 age groups (overlapping groups such as '1 year to under 15 years' and its 5-year subgroups are both published and both kept), nationality (German/foreign nationals), and nature of injury (ICD-10 S-T chapter groups; 'Total' = S00-T98). Values kept exactly as published including symbols: '.' = 'Wert unbekannt oder geheimzuhalten' (unknown or suppressed for confidentiality), '-' = 'nichts vorhanden' (none/zero) per the GBE FAQ. German thousands separator '.' removed from numbers (e.g. 1.617 -> 1617). Check: sum of the 16 Länder equals the published Germany total in every year where no Land value is suppressed; small gaps (1-5) exist only in years with '.' cells. Source footnote: 'Berichtsjahr 2019: Von zwei Bundesländern wurden auf regionaler Ebene aus Geheimhaltungsgründen andere Daten veröffentlicht' (minor differences possible vs. Länder publications). The table does not state whether regional assignment is by place of residence or place of death.

eurostat_cod.name: Eurostat causes of death by NUTS region: hlth_cd_acdr, hlth_cd_acdr2, hlth_cd_asdr2, hlth_cd_ycdr2, hlth_cd_ycdrf, hlth_cd_ycdrm, hlth_cd_ycdrt, hlth_cd_ynrf, hlth_cd_ynrm, hlth_cd_ynrt, hlth_cd_yro, hlth_cd_ysdr1, hlth_cd_ysdr2 - cause 'Assault' (ICD-10 X85-Y09, Y87.1; Eurostat code X85-Y09_Y871)
eurostat_cod.publisher: Eurostat (compiled from national cause-of-death statistics: Statbel for Belgium, TurkStat for Türkiye, Destatis for Germany)
eurostat_cod.licence: Eurostat: reuse authorised, source to be acknowledged (CC BY 4.0)
eurostat_cod.notes: Vital-registration deaths from assault, not police-recorded crime. Datasets: hlth_cd_asdr2 (annual age-standardised death rate per 100,000, 2011-2023, by NUTS 2 region of residence; age groups total / under 65 / 65 and over), hlth_cd_acdr2 (annual crude death rate per 100,000, 2011-2023, by age group), hlth_cd_yro (number of deaths, 3-year average, 2013-2023, by residence/occurrence categories), hlth_cd_ysdr2 and hlth_cd_ycdr2 (3-year average standardised and crude rates, 2013-2023), and where published the historical series hlth_cd_acdr, hlth_cd_ysdr1, hlth_cd_ycdrt/f/m, hlth_cd_ynrt/f/m (1994-2010). Eurostat metadata (hlth_cdeath_sims): 3-year averages are 'the average of year, year -1 and year -2'; crude death rate is 'expressed in deaths per 100 000 inhabitants'. Every sex, age group and residence category Eurostat publishes is kept (overlapping age groups included as published). Eurostat flag 'd' = 'definition differs (see metadata)', kept in the breakdown text. Empty cells are not in the files (SDMX-CSV lists only published observations). Raw per-country extracts in raw/eurostat/.
